purpose: Subjective rating rubric for review-task builds. Used by human reviewers and intended as the specification for future LLM auto-rating.

levels.description: Completely non-functional, or the app fails to load at all.
Loads a UI, but missing nearly all major pieces.
UI loads and looks correct, but multiple major functions are broken, plus multiple other bugs or issues.
One major function broken; multiple minor bugs observed.
One major function broken; few minor bugs observed.
Fully functional with workarounds; multiple observable minor bugs (e.g. UI broken or ugly).
Fully functional with a workaround; only one easily observable minor bug.
Fully functional without minor bugs, but the UI is substandard.
Fully functional, no minor bugs; UI meets expectations.
Fully functional, no minor bugs; UI surpasses expectations.
